title: Deepen FS3 operations, cost, performance reproducibility and report evidence
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 6, 2026 approval to proceed with the proposed priorities. Verify the PR #51 production Pages deployment; deepen public evidence for operations and facilities across the 27-system HPCI inventory; distinguish public contract and award totals from provider-reported approximate payments; improve EEA1 reproducibility using immutable public proxy assets without representing them as EEA1-matched inputs; and add report-ready claim-readiness and planning-option evidence tables. Use public information only, preserve unsupported values as Coverage Gaps, keep all outputs provisional and Consensus-incomplete, and publish the resulting Pages changes in a Pull Request against main. This directive does not authorize merging the Pull Request, enabling unattended production research, assigning scores or rankings, setting procurement specifications, or treating proxy inputs as confirmed EEA1 inputs.
